info.title: MoEngage On-Site Messaging (OSM) Template API
info.description: API for creating, updating, and searching On-Site Messaging (OSM) templates within the MoEngage platform.

tags.name: OSM Templates
tags.description: Operations to manage On-Site Messaging (OSM) templates.

dc.description: The ‘dc’ in the API Endpoint URL refers to the MoEngage Data Center (DC). MoEngage hosts each customer in a different DC. You can find your DC number and replace the value of ‘dc’ in the URL by referring to the DC and API endpoint mapping [here](/api/introduction#data-centers). Your MoEngage Data Center (DC) can be 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, or 101.

post.description: This API creates a new On-Site Messaging (OSM) template. You can use this API to upload templates created outside the MoEngage ecosystem to MoEngage and use them for campaign creation.

x-mint.content:
<Note>
API templates cannot be used in the Drag and Drop Editor in the MoEngage Dashboard. They are only supported for the Custom HTML Editor.
</Note>

#### Rate Limit
The rate limit is 100 RPM. You can upload a maximum of 100 templates per minute.

requestBody.description: The details of the OSM template to be created.

external_template_id.description: The unique ID assigned to the newly created template by MoEngage. This ID is used for subsequent updates or searches.

400.description: Bad Request. Returned when required parameters are missing, invalid, or when a template already exists with the same version, name, or ID.

401.description: Authentication Failure. Returned when authorization parameters are missing or invalid.

415.description: Unsupported Media Type. Returned when the header Content-Type is not provided or is not supported.

429.description: Rate limit breached. Returned when requests per minute exceed the limit or template quota is exceeded.

error.message: API rate limit breached. Current limit: n/m mins

5XX.description: Internal Server Error. Returned when the system runs into an unexpected error.

post.description: This API searches the OSM templates created in your MoEngage account.

x-mint.content:
<Note>
**Mandatory Pagination**
We are introducing mandatory pagination, effective **November 15, 2025**. All calls to this API must include the following two parameters:

* `page`: The page number of the results you wish to fetch.
* `entries`: The number of templates to return per page, with a maximum value of *15*.

Please update all integrations to include these parameters. API requests submitted without them after the effective date will result in an error and fail to execute.
</Note>

<Information>
* If the request body is passed empty, then all templates will be returned.
* The `preview_image` field in the response will be generated by MoEngage for the HTML template payload.
</Information>

#### Rate Limit
The rate limit is 100 RPM.

basicAuth.description:
Authentication is done via Basic Auth. This requires a base64-encoded string of your credentials in the format 'username:password'.

- **Username**: Use your MoEngage workspace ID (also known as the App ID). You can find it in the MoEngage dashboard at **Settings** > **Account** > **APIs** > **Workspace ID (earlier app id)**.
- **Password**: Use your API Key, which you can find within the **Campaign report/Business events/Custom templates/Catalog API/Inform Report** tile.

For more information on authentication and getting your credentials, refer [here](https://www.moengage.com/docs/api/introduction#getting-your-credentials).

StandardErrorResponse.description: Standard error structure used for 400 and 429 responses.

code.description: A brief explanation of the error.

message.description: Describes why the request failed (e.g., Duplicate - template_id).

details.description: A list of error detail objects containing code, target, and specific messages.

target.description: Denotes the field causing the issue.

SimpleErrorResponse.description: Simplified error structure used for 401, 415, and 5xx responses.

description.description: A description of the error (used in 401/415).

message.description: A message describing the error (used in 5xx).

basic_details.description: Details about the template, including its payload and template type.

payload.description:
Payload type must be HTML. The data type is a string.
* No limit restriction on field length.
* For payload structure examples, see the main endpoint documentation.

template_type.description: The type of template being created.

meta_info.description: This field contains information about the template being created, such as its name, version, ID, and the creator's details.

created_by.description: Identifier for the creator of the template (e.g., email).

template_id.description: A unique ID for the template provided by you.

external_template_id.description: The unique identifier generated by MoEngage during template creation.

update_campaigns.description:
Flag to update all campaigns currently using this template to the newer version.
* **`true`**: All campaigns running with this template will be updated.
* **`false`**: A new version of the template is created; existing campaigns remain unchanged.

payload.description:
The updated HTML content.
* Payload type must be HTML.
* No limit restriction on field length.

meta_info.description: Updates template information such as name, version, and updater details.

template_name.description: The name of the template being updated.

template_id.description: A unique ID for the template provided by you.

template_version.description: Optional new version for the template. The version will be increased by 1 automatically after every update.

updated_by.description: The email ID of the person updating the template.

SearchOsmTemplateRequest.description:
**Notes:**
- `page` and `entries` are mandatory effective November 15, 2025. All other fields are optional.
- An empty request body will fetch all templates.

page.description: The index of the page to be returned. Mandatory after Nov 15, 2025.

entries.description: The number of entries/templates to return per page. Max 15. Mandatory after Nov 15, 2025.

template_name.description: The name of the template to search for. Returns templates matching this name.

template_id.description: The unique ID of the template provided by you.

template_type.description: Filter templates by type (Custom or Pre-built).

created_by.description: Filter templates by the creator's email identifier.

updated_by.description: Filter templates by the updater's email identifier.

sort_params.description: Sort the templates by multiple fields in ASCENDING or DESCENDING order. Priority follows the array order.

external_template_ids.description: Search for multiple templates using pairs of `external_template_id` and `version`.

external_template_id.description: The unique system-generated ID for the template.

version.description: The numeric version of the template.

payload.description: The HTML payload of the template.

preview_image.description: A preview image URL generated by MoEngage for the HTML payload.

channel.description: The channel associated with the template.

template_source.description: The source of the template creation.

template_type.description: The type classification of the template.

created_by.description: The user who created the template.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the template was created.

updated_by.description: The user who last updated the template.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the template was last updated.

data.description: A list containing the details of the templates found.
